reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with the terrain in Provincia. With our new native sparse CA, ponds are now more efficient, and terrain edits like raising or digging will seamlessly integrate with water flow. No more freezing frames when turning on a well! Dive into the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: Water Mechanics Revamped in Provincia!
steam.body: We're excited to share that we've revamped the water mechanics in Provincia! With the new native sparse CA, water now interacts more efficiently with terrain changes. Enjoy smoother gameplay without freezing frames when turning on wells. Learn more about these updates and how they enhance your city-building experience here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
